interface_changes: Probe top-level now carries probe_id, forward_id, batch_id, batch_identity_stable, structural input_signature and bounded input_output_paths.

Each retained and failure-location call adds invocation_id, probe_id, forward_id, batch_id, alias_paths, parent_invocation_id, input_signature and input_output_paths while retaining legacy call_id/parent_call_id/paths.
batch_id is stable only when the Dataset observation has both a data fingerprint and stable sample IDs; other batch factories receive an execution-local opaque ID.
implemented: Structural input signatures hash tensor shape/dtype/device and bounded nested structure, excluding tensor contents and scalar values.
Calls across shared module aliases retain distinct per-call inputs and scoped IDs; the last call identity remains available on FORWARD_FAILED, including after trace truncation.
Existing TTY ProbeCache continues to browse the captured report and layer details without dispatching a new forward; its cache is scoped by model/batch/variant/seed selections.

validation.scope: Different shapes through one shared Linear remain separate; repeated input signatures remain structural while probe/forward IDs differ; different input batch produces new IDs; failure report carries last-call scope; paths include inputs/outputs.
5 existing forward-probe CLI regressions, including shared calls, Dataset observations, failure location/truncation and managed training probe.

notes: Direct batch IDs are intentionally execution-local because identical factory references do not prove identical batch contents.
input_signature is a structural tensor signature, not a content digest or proof of semantic equivalence.
